paragraphs: The Magyar Huszar is the Magyars' distinctive cavalry warrior, riding into battle with a long lance and a broad shield. In Age of Empires, it combines speed with the striking power needed to hunt vulnerable targets.
This series follows the Elite Magyar Huszar into equal-resource battles against the other civilizations' troops.

The Elite Magyar Huszar deals extra damage to siege weapons, making it dangerous when it reaches an enemy's artillery. Its speed helps it close quickly, but spearmen and camel riders remain serious threats.
The Magyars' Corvinian Army technology can replace its gold cost with additional food, giving this cavalry a special role when gold becomes scarce.
